settings.heading: Contact
settings.body:
Write to us and a person reads it.

Order questions

Have your order number ready — it's in your confirmation email and starts with a #. Damaged or misprinted items: send a photo and we'll sort it without needing the piece back.

Everything else

Wholesale, press, collaborations, or a question about the word itself. All welcome.

Response time

One business day, usually less.
